title: LGS after update - closed loop not working
symptom: After updating AAPS to version 3.0.0.1, the closed loop stops working after a few minutes and falls back to Low Glucose Suspend (LGS). The user has reinstalled the app multiple times, restarted the phone, and reconnected the pump, but the issue persists.
cause: The red triangle warning 'BG too close' indicates that BGs are not reliable, which prevents the loop from closing. This is not a bug.
fix: The user needs to delete the unreliable BG readings (the red triangle) to allow the loop to close. The thread suggests that this is a known issue and not a bug.
evidence_quote: You can't close the loop because of the red triangle (BGs are not reliable). This is not a bug.
